sections.title: Biomedical Information Systems Analysis and Design
sections.description: This course provides an introduction to the concepts and principles of information systems analysis and design, focusing on the techniques of the Unified Modeling Language and the Unified Process, specifically as these apply to healthcare settings. As a result, there is a strong emphasis on applying these techniques to real-world issues with clinical and clinical research information systems. These include the electronic health record, information systems in clinical specialties, and systems to support the management of data used for clinical research and healthcare administration. This course is required for MBMI students in the Healthcare Quality Informatics Track.
